purpose: Record the playable lower-gap route that reaches the first vertical rope and separate it from the unresolved rope-top transfer.

milestones.description: The player crosses the lower gap branch and reaches the lower floor without entering a terminal scene state.
The timed jump reaches the vertical rope approach.
The player attaches to the vertical rope and climbs to its upper stop while the scene remains state 0x01.

confirmed: The lower gap is a playable route, not an automatic death transition.
The vertical rope at world X 0x0838 is reached by a timed jump from the lower floor.
The rope climb is driven by terrain behavior 0x22 and reaches the upper rope stop.

transfer.description: A timed jump to the left dismounts from the upper rope stop onto the upper platform. A symmetric jump to the right falls into the lower band.

nearby_actor.observed_effect: The actor disappears when approached; PLAYER_VY follows the ordinary jump sequence and does not receive the bounce impulse.

jump_timing_sweep.description: All tested timings either stop at the rope around X=2104 or fall to the lower floor around X=2176; none reaches the forward upper edge.

interpretation.unresolved: The transfer returns to the already-known upper platform; the forward path beyond that platform still reaches the non-landing upper edge rather than the scene transition corridor.

next_action: Search the earlier bounce/handhold branch around world X 0x0540-0x0678; this rope/upper-platform branch is locally exhausted without reaching the forward scene-transition corridor.
